features: Comfort and Effortless Typing: Standard-size keyboard with low profile, soft, responsive keys tested to 10 million key-presses for a fast and effortless typing experience
Sleek and Compact Design: ProDot keyboard features a sleek, smart and compact design for comfortable working. It is manufactured from ABS plastic for strength and durability
Seamless Connection: Seamless connection with USB port ensures that there's no disturbance in working. Wire length ensures durability and hassle-free connection
Plug and Play: The Standard Keyboard can be directly plugged right out of the box and played without any driver installation needed. Compatible with Windows, Mac OS, Laptop
Spill-Resistant Design: ProDot Keyboard provides protection from accidental spills by allowing liquid to drain out from holes in the keyboard that can be simply wiped dry
Type-C Connectivity: Features modern Type-C wired connection for reliable and fast data transfer with compatible devices including laptops and mobile phones
104 Keys with Rupee Symbol: Full-size keyboard layout with 104 keys including dedicated Rupee currency symbol key for convenient typing in Indian currency format
Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly with multiple operating systems including Windows, iOS, and Linux for versatile usage across different devices
